payload.content: A parking-reservation WordPress website guiding travellers from trip dates and parking choice to booking, with optional charging, washing and refuelling services alongside the main journey.
payload.description_1: Schipholparkeren has to turn a travel plan into a parking reservation without making visitors search for the practical steps. Travellers arrive with dates, flight timing, luggage and different expectations about valet or comfort parking.
payload.description_2: I designed Schipholparkeren around the reservation sequence a traveller actually follows. Trip dates and the parking choice come first, followed by the details needed to complete a booking and any optional car services that fit the journey. The same hierarchy keeps the next action visible without adding unnecessary decision points.
